digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapters - rich text encoding
propositions: Rich-text encoding differs between Jira Cloud (Atlassian Document Format/ADF) and Data Center (plain text/wiki markup), requiring a shared abstraction to eliminate duplication in adapters/jira/backend.py and PR #120's copied method.

A RichTextCodec Protocol with four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must preserve Cloud's existing behavior where fit and normalize are composed separately by different callers.

AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/ (not jira_family/) to respect J2's import contract forbidding jira_family from importing Cloud vendor modules, while WikiTextCodec lives in jira_family/rich_text.py.

The shared map_fields_to_remote implementation must relocate to adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py as a single real body, with Cloud backend.py delegating to it rather than maintaining a duplicate.

WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 characters) with marker '[truncated by reconciler]', matching adf._ADF_TRUNCATION_SUFFIX so deployment-agnostic tooling sees consistent output.

All four acceptance criteria must pass: parameterized contract tests on both codecs, ADF output matching J1 pinned values, zero new ADF references outside the codec (verified by allowlist test), and exactly one real map_fields_to_remote implementation in the tree.
